pictures.author: Balon Greyjoy
pictures.license: CC0 1.0, per licensing section; viewed only
pictures.observations: Actually inspected restored east-facing stepped terraces: broad steep stairs with moulded flanks, heavily coursed dark sandstone, low open galleries with lintels and posts, narrow gopura crown and an open upper terrace without a tall sanctuary spire.

pictures.author: Balon Greyjoy
pictures.license: CC0 1.0, per licensing section; viewed only
pictures.observations: Actually inspected the west facade: enormous low-contrast stone reclining Buddha incorporated into the ruined wall, head toward the north, its broad face projecting from coarse blocks, with elongated body toward the south. Missing blocks and irregular silhouette remain visible.

pictures.author: Balon Greyjoy
pictures.observations: Actually inspected upper gallery: open stone doorways with stepped corbel crowns, carved inset broad pediment and door jambs; extensive roof loss and irregular stepped wall tops. Despite file name this shows an upper walkway, not the long eastern causeway.

pictures.author: Jorge Láscar
pictures.observations: Actually inspected eastern staircase and moulded terrace bands; temporary restoration scaffold is present and is omitted from the present-day model. The restored 2019 exterior controls current roof loss.
